title: Peytn has released an new sonic banger titled "Russian Roulette"
htmlContent:
Peytn has released an new sonic banger titled "Russian Roulette," a new hot trending sound that was released on the 23rd of September 2022. He comes with a confident energy that is electrifying. Within the lyrics, he discusses struggling to break through in the industry.

“Russian Roulette” is a certified hit, and Peytn wants everyone to know it. He plans on keeping the same energy as the year goes on. The flow is on point and delivers everything with supreme confidence that shines n the record, to make something that will keep any party going to the fullest.
